title.narrative: National Programme for Tuberculosis Control and Chest Diseases - Sri Lanka (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Sri Lanka, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (MOH)This program has the following goals: Achieve universal access to TB diagnosis and treatment by 2025, and to get on track to achieve End TB targets by 2035 and reduce TB incidence by 21% until 2027 (49/100.000). The objectives of this program are: To find and successfully treat, on average, between 2025 and 2027, 10,000 cases of drug sensitive TB annually, including 600 children. To successfully treat, on average, 4000 - 5000 eligible cases for TB preventive treatment (TPT) between 2025 and 2027.. To efficiently engage the private sector in TB diagnosis and management, and to increase all cases notified from the non NTP sector to 35% by 2027. To ensure the availability of complete, accurate and timely quarterly data from all districts at central level by fully functionalizing the EPIMS
